scope: Three alternating before/after trials of the existing mobile-regular native fixture; all other Godot/browser/movie work stopped. Seed 451; 844x390, 25 synthetic initial enemies, normal HP, canonical combat, 30 warmup + 180 measured frames per trial. Not device or display-presented FPS.

1-after.method: Fixed 60 Hz input/simulation, 30 warmup + 180 measured native rendered frames per fixture; sequential runs on Xorg llvmpipe, vsync off. Intervals include rendering/scheduler/readback synchronization; not display presentation or GPU timing. 25/90 enemy starts are synthetic, normal HP and canonical combat.
